experiments.body: Report whether the red-clothed person visibly leaves the platform and stands or moves in the track bed. Sitting on the edge alone is ambiguous.
Review the sequence in time order: platform approach, seated edge, descent, track-bed presence. Decide only whether descent or track-bed presence is visible.
Report whether the person visibly handles or manipulates the gate area. Successful opening is not required; distinguish uncertain tool identity.
Review approach, contact with the gate area, crouching and departure. Decide whether visible gate manipulation occurs, independently of whether opening occurs.

suffix: Do not use camera names as evidence. Return only a JSON object with exactly these keys: "outcome" ("supported", "not_observed", or "uncertain"), "evidence" (short visible facts), "timing" (approximate seconds relative to clip start, or unknown), "limitations" (what this clip cannot establish). Do not infer intent or facts outside the clip.
source_policy: Use exact saved intervals only if recording availability is verified. Never substitute a later repetition silently.
negative_control_policy: No new controls in this batch. Short pre-entry and departure periods are frame-level diagnostics only. Busy street is a reused domain-mismatched control; open-lane traffic loops too quickly. No eligible distinct task-matched negative event is established.
